review_scope: Compared all 23 main and candidate frames for framing, visibility and surface discontinuities. Brightness differences are recorded per view.

images.observation: The table, radio, colored floor patch and wall light occupy the same positions.
Tile courses remain visible through the lower half of the flashlight pool beside the curtain.
The apron, table edge, foreground chair and blinds remain distinct in the lit room.
The wall light falls behind the shelving and window. Floorboard directions remain legible.
The wall light has a different mottled perimeter. Counter edges, sink and pipework retain their shapes.
The round gauge, front plate and overhead piping separate from the dark wall.
Shelf edges remain visible behind the chair. The lit hall frames the closed door.
The vertical fitting runs along the tile corner above the cistern. Shadows along the tiles are somewhat darker.
The wooden frame and pulley remain visible through the opening. The wall highlight differs near the sill.
The leaf stands open beside the three upper connections and lower control bank.
The narrow brass rail crosses the dark recess above the tiled floor. The recess is difficult to read in both captures.
The red shelf figure can be distinguished from the wood and the portrait at left. Both views are dim.
The ceiling beam partly screens the shelf at this angle. Frames and shelf light retain their positions.
The open brass compartment, banks of doors and bench remain separate against the dark wainscot.
Fins and valve remain visible beneath the curtains. The table and blinds retain clear outlines.
The landing rails and fenced machinery retain their alignment beside the roof door.
The tank, steel supports and perimeter walkway are clearly outlined against the skyline.
The illuminated strips and red interior component remain visible. The casing top looks darker in the candidate.
The wall brackets, cistern lid and dark rim remain distinguishable against the tile.
The colored spill and scattered tendrils read against the floor within the flashlight beam.
The upright reddish tendrils are distinguishable from the radiator fins. Both cast detail within the lit patch.
The toaster and canisters reflect a much darker tone in the candidate. Tray, slats, crumbs and surrounding objects retain their silhouettes.
The metal box remains dark. The station plate and brass fitting are visible in both captures.
